steps.name: ablation-variants
steps.summary: 7 ablation manifests written under variants/ablation_*.yaml. All pass research-mode validation (cutoff=2024-12-31 enforced, embargo_days=20). Single-key variants: no_vtg/no_growth_tilt/no_pead/no_mega_funding/revision_down_only/feature_mode_lean. Composite: all_overlays_off (6 overlays off + lean panel). VTG-preserving single-overlay variants retain the production VTG settings so each variant truly isolates ONE knob from iter15_FINAL_postfix.

steps.name: ablation-runner
steps.summary: scripts/run_ablation.py executed 7 ablation variants (research mode, embargo+cutoff). Two robustness fixes during execution: (a) errors='replace' on subprocess decode (cp949 in Korean Windows console), (b) pkl truncation detection (size < 50MB threshold) auto-triggers re-run. Initial run had 5 truncated pkls + 1 transient OOM; final retry produced all 7 valid artifacts (0 failures). summary.csv adds cutoff-trimmed columns (Task A step 2 methodology). Trimmed IR vs baseline (0.392): no_vtg=-0.046, no_growth_tilt=-0.182, no_pead=-0.106, no_mega_funding=-0.185, revision_down_only=+0.290, feature_mode_lean=+0.506, all_overlays_off=-0.047. KEY FINDING: 'core' feature whitelist (+0.506 if removed) and 'reversion_gated' revision cleaning (+0.290 if rolled back) are net-negative overlays under honest evaluation.
